extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Different types of food — energy food (rice, wheat, chapati, potato — give energy to work and play), body-building food (dal, milk, eggs, fish, meat — build muscles and bones), protective food (fruits, vegetables, amla — vitamins and minerals protect from disease). A balanced diet has all three types. (2) Shelters of living beings — shelter is a safe place to live. Humans: houses (brick), huts (mud and thatch), apartments (tall buildings). Birds: nests (twigs on trees). Rabbits: burrows (underground holes). Lions/tigers: caves or dens. Snakes: holes in ground. Fish: water (rivers, ponds). Spiders: webs. Different animals need different shelters. (3) Local travel and transport — land transport: bus, car, bicycle, train, auto-rickshaw, walking. Water transport: boat, ship, ferry. Air transport: aeroplane, helicopter. Animal transport: bullock cart, horse ride. Public transport (bus, train) is shared by many people. Personal transport (bicycle, car) is for one family. (4) Simple crafts — clay: make pots, diyas, statues, toys (clay is natural mud). Paper: make boats, planes, greeting cards, origami. Drawing: use crayons, pencils, colors to make pictures. Cloth: simple stitching, embroidery. Crafts develop creativity and hand skills. Misconceptions: 'only humans need shelter' (all living beings need shelter — birds need nests, animals need caves/burrows), 'rice and apple are the same food type' (rice is energy food, apple is protective food), 'bicycle is public transport' (bicycle is personal transport — public transport is shared like bus and train), 'clay and paper are the same material' (clay is mud/earth for pots, paper is for folding and drawing), 'all animals live in caves' (different animals have different shelters — birds build nests, rabbits dig burrows, fish live in water). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function FoodShelterGame), NOT export default. Export interface FoodShelterGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
